mapper.sql: l.pr_line_id, l.pr_id, p.pr_no, p.status as pr_status, p.plant_cd, l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, l.unit_cd, trim_scale(l.qty)::text as qty, l.need_date, l.line_status, c.cust_cd as pref_cust_cd
mapper.select: select * from ( select , trim_scale(coalesce(o.ordered, 0))::text as ordered_qty, trim_scale(l.qty - coalesce(o.ordered, 0))::text as remain_qty, l.qty - coalesce(o.ordered, 0) as remain_num from srm_pr_line l join srm_pr p on p.pr_id = l.pr_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = l.pref_cust_id left join lateral (select sum(pl.qty - pl.cancel_qty) as ordered from srm_po_line pl join srm_po po on po.po_id = pl.po_id where pl.pr_line_id = l.pr_line_id and po.status <> 'CANCELLED' and pl.line_status <> 'CANCELLED') o on true where p.status = 'APPROVED' and l.line_status = 'OPEN' and i.item_cd = #{itemCd} and (p.pr_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or i.item_cd ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or i.item_nm ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\') ) x where x.remain_num > 0 order by x.need_date nulls last, x.pr_no, x.pr_line_id limit 500
select l.pr_line_id from srm_pr_line l join srm_pr p on p.pr_id = l.pr_id where l.pr_line_id in #{id} order by l.pr_line_id for update of l for share of p

select , trim_scale(coalesce(o.ordered, 0))::text as ordered_qty, trim_scale(l.qty - coalesce(o.ordered, 0))::text as remain_qty from srm_pr_line l join srm_pr p on p.pr_id = l.pr_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = l.pref_cust_id left join lateral (select sum(pl.qty - pl.cancel_qty) as ordered from srm_po_line pl join srm_po po on po.po_id = pl.po_id where pl.pr_line_id = l.pr_line_id and po.status <> 'CANCELLED' and pl.line_status <> 'CANCELLED' and pl.po_id <> #{exceptPoId}) o on true where l.pr_line_id in #{id} order by l.pr_line_id
mapper.sql: p.po_id, p.po_no, p.rev, p.po_date, p.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, s.trade_status, p.plant_cd, pl.plant_nm, p.wh_id, w.node_cd as wh_cd, w.node_nm as wh_nm, p.currency_cd, p.pay_terms_cd, p.buyer_user_id, bu.user_nm as buyer_nm, p.status, p.apr_request_id, p.issued_at, p.issued_by, p.cancel_reason, trim_scale(p.total_amt)::text as total_amt, p.source, p.remark, (select m.external_id from mst_ext_id_map m where m.entity_type = 'PO' and m.internal_id = p.po_id and m.use_yn = 'Y' order by m.map_id limit 1) as erp_po_no, (select count(*) from srm_po_line l where l.po_id = p.po_id) as line_cnt, p.row_ver, p.updated_at, p.updated_by

select l.po_line_id, l.po_id, l.line_no, l.item_id, i.item_cd, l.item_nm, i.use_yn as item_use_yn, l.supplier_item_cd, l.unit_cd, trim_scale(l.qty)::text as qty, trim_scale(l.unit_price)::text as unit_price, trim_scale(l.amt)::text as amt, l.due_date, l.pr_line_id, r.pr_no, trim_scale(l.cancel_qty)::text as cancel_qty, l.line_status, l.remark, coalesce(l.due_date < p.po_date + src.lead_days, false) as lead_short, coalesce(l.qty < src.moq, false) as moq_short, coalesce(src.order_mult is not null and mod(l.qty, src.order_mult) <> 0, false) as mult_off from srm_po_line l join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join srm_source src on src.cust_id = p.cust_id and src.item_id = l.item_id and src.use_yn = 'Y' left join srm_pr_line rl on rl.pr_line_id = l.pr_line_id left join srm_pr r on r.pr_id = rl.pr_id where l.po_id = #{poId} order by l.line_no
select rev, issued_at, issued_by from srm_po_rev where po_id = #{poId} order by rev desc

insert into srm_po (comp_cd, po_no, po_date, cust_id, plant_cd, wh_id, currency_cd, pay_terms_cd, buyer_user_id, total_amt, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{poNo}, #{poDate}, #{custId}, #{f.plantCd}, #{f.whId}, #{currencyCd}, #{f.payTermsCd}, #{buyerUserId}, #{f.totalAmt}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning po_id
mapper.update: update srm_po set plant_cd = #{f.plantCd}, wh_id = #{f.whId}, pay_terms_cd = #{f.payTermsCd}, remark = #{f.remark}, total_amt = #{f.totalAmt}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where po_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(line_no), 0) + 1 from srm_po_line where po_id = #{poId}
mapper.insert: insert into srm_po_line (comp_cd, po_id, line_no, item_id, item_nm, supplier_item_cd, unit_cd, qty, unit_price, amt, due_date, pr_line_id, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{poId}, #{lineNo}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.itemNm}, #{f.supplierItemCd}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.qty}, #{f.unitPrice}, #{f.amt}, #{f.dueDate}, #{f.prLineId}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.update: update srm_po_line set item_id = #{f.itemId}, item_nm = #{f.itemNm}, supplier_item_cd = #{f.supplierItemCd}, unit_cd = #{f.unitCd}, qty = #{f.qty}, unit_price = #{f.unitPrice}, amt = #{f.amt}, due_date = #{f.dueDate}, pr_line_id = #{f.prLineId}, remark = #{f.remark}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where po_line_id = #{f.poLineId} and ((item_id, qty, unit_price, amt, due_date) is distinct from (#{f.itemId}::bigint, #{f.qty}::numeric, #{f.unitPrice}::numeric, #{f.amt}::numeric, #{f.dueDate}::date) or item_nm is distinct from #{f.itemNm}::varchar or supplier_item_cd is distinct from #{f.supplierItemCd}::varchar or unit_cd is distinct from #{f.unitCd}::varchar or pr_line_id is distinct from #{f.prLineId}::bigint or remark is distinct from #{f.remark}::varchar)
mapper.sql: jsonb_build_object( 'po', jsonb_build_object('poNo', p.po_no, 'rev', p.rev, 'poDate', p.po_date, 'custCd', c.cust_cd, 'custNm', c.cust_nm, 'plantCd', p.plant_cd, 'whCd', w.node_cd, 'currencyCd', p.currency_cd, 'payTermsCd', p.pay_terms_cd, 'totalAmt', trim_scale(p.total_amt)::text, 'remark', p.remark), 'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'lineNo', l.line_no, 'itemCd', i.item_cd, 'itemNm', l.item_nm, 'supplierItemCd', l.supplier_item_cd, 'unitCd', l.unit_cd, 'qty', trim_scale(l.qty)::text, 'unitPrice', trim_scale(l.unit_price)::text, 'amt', trim_scale(l.amt)::text, 'dueDate', l.due_date, 'lineStatus', l.line_status) order by l.line_no) from srm_po_line l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.po_id = p.po_id), '[]'::jsonb))
mapper.select: select snapshot::text from srm_po_rev where po_id = #{id} and rev = #{rev}
select (select l.approver_id from apr_line l where l.apr_id = r.apr_id and l.status = 'CURRENT') as current_id, r.requester_id from apr_request r where r.apr_id = #{aprId} and r.status = 'PENDING'

select p.po_no, p.rev, c.cust_nm, sc.comp_nm, p.currency_cd, trim_scale(p.total_amt)::text as total_amt, (select count(*) from srm_po_line l where l.po_id = p.po_id) as line_cnt, (select min(l.due_date) from srm_po_line l where l.po_id = p.po_id) as first_due, coalesce((select ct.email from mst_cust_contact ct where ct.cust_id = p.cust_id and ct.use_yn = 'Y' and ct.main_yn = 'Y' and ct.email is not null order by ct.contact_id limit 1), c.email) as email from srm_po p join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = p.cust_id join sys_comp sc on sc.comp_cd = p.comp_cd where p.po_id = #{id}
select coalesce(sum(amt), 0) from srm_po_line where po_id = #{poId}
select system_id from mst_ext_system where system_cd = #{systemCd} and system_type = 'ERP' and use_yn = 'Y'
select internal_id from mst_ext_id_map where system_id = #{systemId} and entity_type = #{entityType} and external_id = #{externalId} and use_yn = 'Y'
select item_cd from mst_item where item_id = #{itemId}
